rationale.rules-based-checks: ACCA deterministically assembles and symbolically executes AI-generated snippets against references.
rationale.formal-methods: Symbolic execution and SMT solving establish semantic equivalence across execution paths.
rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: Automated assessment targets manual review's time, expertise, scale, and error burdens.
rationale.quality-debt: Five generators produced substantial rates of semantically incorrect, non-security code.
rationale.framework: ACCA specifies a reusable multi-stage correctness-assessment workflow and public implementation.
rationale.built-system: Authors implemented ACCA with NASM, ANGR, and Z3 and released it.
rationale.assistive: Models translate human natural-language requests into snippet-granularity code suggestions.
rationale.metrics: Defines binary syntactic and semantic correctness scores measuring quality.
rationale.risk-quality: Evaluates and mitigates semantic-correctness defects in AI-generated code.
rationale.method-experiment: Controlled comparisons characterize five third-party generators and multiple assessment baselines.
